svg.metadata: {"id": "s055", "name": "木工劳技室", "cat": "艺术与劳动", "tags": ["劳动", "木工", "劳动技术", "动手实践"], "desc": "劳动技术木工教室：洞洞板上挂着锯、锤、尺、角尺等工具，厚实木工台带台钳，木板堆、锯木马、做好的小鸟屋与刨花。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [600, 1300]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "window", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pegboard", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "planks", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "bench", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "bench_items", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sawhorse", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "shavings", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamp", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#E3EDDD", "wall2": "#CFE0C6", "peg": "#E8CFA4", "peg2": "#D3B27E", "hole": "#B99668", "top": "#D9A566", "top2": "#B98146", "leg": "#9A6638", "leg2": "#7E512B", "plank1": "#F0C891", "plank2": "#E3B577", "plank3": "#CF9C5E", "metal": "#8C98A6", "metal2": "#C2CAD4", "red": "#E8584A", "orange": "#F2973E", "yellow": "#F2C14E", "blue": "#4F8FC9", "green": "#6FB27C", "floor1": "#D7D2C8", "floor2": "#BFB8AC", "shav": "#F6DDB2", "bird": "#5FA8A0", "roof": "#E57766", "win1": "#A9DDF5", "win2": "#EAF7FF", "goggle": "#9FD8F0"}}
